question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative that best expresses the meaning of the idiom or phrase.**

To strain every nerve

options.text: To manipulate someone in the best way

solution:
The correct answer is **"To make a great effort."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The phrase **"to strain every nerve"** is an idiom that means to make an intense effort, to put in maximum effort, or to exert oneself to the fullest extent. (गहन प्रयास करना, अधिकतम प्रयास करना, या अपने आप को पूरी तरह से प्रयास करना।)
 
• It suggests pushing one's capabilities or resources to the maximum in order to achieve a goal or overcome a challenge.
 
 
• **Example**:* She was determined to succeed in the competition, willing **to strain every nerve**__ to achieve her goal.*
 
 
 
• It is often used to convey a sense of dedication, determination, and hard work in pursuing a particular objective.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
